Name: Potatoes' Cozy Furniture - Joja's Replacement
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
This is a furniture mod that replaces Joja's furniture with new ones. It's very "mushrooms and witchy" themed. You don't need Alternative Textures or any other mod for it to work besides Content Patcher.

[b]﻿Update:[/b] There's now an option for a[b] Standalone Catalogue instead of replacing Joja's furniture![/b] For this version, you will need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423?tab=posts&BH=2]MMAP[/url]. This version candles illuminate the ambient.﻿
This update is all thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LunariaFaye/mods]LunariaFaye[/url]! She did the coding, allowing the mod to have its own standalone option. Go check out her account for amazing mods!

[line]
[size=3][b] ﻿How to Install

[/b][/size][b]﻿ ﻿Replacing Joja's Furniture:[/b]
[b]1.[/b] Download the "Joja's Replacement Catalogue" file (don't download the Potatoes' Catalogue version).
[b]2.[/b] Drop this mod inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
Done :)
﻿Optional: Install SpaceCore so each furniture has unique description. You don't need this for the mod to work, it's a minor detail.

[b] ﻿Standalone Version[/b] (without replacing Joja's):
[b]1. [/b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423?tab=posts&BH=2]MMAP[/url].
[b]2. [/b]Download the "Potatoes' Catalogue" file (don't download the Joja's Replacement version).
[b]3.[/b] Drop this mod inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
That's it! You can buy the new catalogue at Robin's for 25000g.

[line][b]
﻿Changing palettes: [/b]If you would like to use the Bogs' palette, you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Config Mod.[/url] It allows to change the textures in game, anytime you want.
Or, install this mod, start the game then close it to generate a [b]Config file,[/b] then manually edit the "Default" to "Bogs".
[line]
[size=3][b] ﻿Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Bathroom furniture: bathtub, toilet, sink, wall decorations, basket with towels, washing machine with multiple colors, toilet paper, etc.
[*] You can [b]get inside the bathtub[/b] and[b] sit on the toilet.[/b]
[*] The washing machine replaces the dressers, so [b]you can actually put your clothes inside![/b] It doesn't wash them, though.
[*] Rotate the bathtub, toilet and wash machine, for other colors/decor options.
[*] Bed, lamps, stove that replaces fireplace (you can turn it "on" just as you do with the fireplace), wall decor, etc.
[*] [b]Alternative palette to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]Bogs Furniture[/url]![/b] With more green and purple colors, and darker wood. 
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/sxT02rNR/Bog-s.png[/img]             [img]https://i.postimg.cc/sx57n95H/Default.png[/img]

[b][/b][/center][left]﻿[/left][left][b] ﻿﻿Standalone Version:[/b][/left][list]
[*][b]Candles have its own light[/b], illuminating the ambient.
[*]You can buy the catalogue at Robin's for 25000g.
[/list][line]
[b][size=3] ﻿Plans[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][s]I [b]tried [/b]to edit the furniture names and descriptions, but idk how to do that yet. From what I've gathered, it's not possible with some items. I even wrote funny little descriptions for them, but oh well. I will try again, tho.[/s] Both versions the furniture names are edited to match the retexture. In the Joja version the items have descriptions.
[*][s] I want to add light to the candles. I have no idea how. But I will.[/s] LunariaFaye added it to the new standalone version! I might look into if it is easy to add it to the Joja version with just CP.
[*] Some items I would like to animate, since Content Patcher Animations now works again! I want to animate the bathtub water, the washing machine, the disco player, and the teacups.
[*][s] I also intend on trying to do an standalone version (that doesn't replace Joja's furniture).[/s] Done. 
[/list]

I'm also doing a Pastel version, but I got burnt out, and I don't know if anyone is going to use it, so I stopped for now lmao but look how pretty it is
